title: Cech transition functions glue local trivial line bundles
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with an open cover $X=\bigcup_a U_a$. Suppose each $U_a$ carries the trivial invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module] and for every pair $(a,b)$ a unit $g_{ab}\in\Gamma(U_a\cap U_b,\mathcal O_X^\times)$ is given with $g_{aa}=1$, $g_{ba}=g_{ab}^{-1}$, and $g_{ac}=g_{ab}g_{bc}$ on triple overlaps. Then there is an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal L$ [def-sc-invertible-module], unique up to unique isomorphism compatible with the chosen trivializations, whose transition functions are the $g_{ab}$.

source.place: Sheaves Lemma 00AM (sheaves-lemma-glue-sheaves-structures), applied to the rank-one free O_X-modules on the U_a glued along multiplication by g_ab

proof.text: For each index a let $\mathcal F_a=\mathcal O_{U_a}$, viewed as the trivial rank-one $\mathcal O_{U_a}$-module. On $U_{ab}$ define an $\mathcal O_{U_{ab}}$-linear map $\varphi_{ab}:\mathcal F_a|_{U_{ab}}\to\mathcal F_b|_{U_{ab}}$ by multiplication by the unit $g_{ab}$; its inverse is multiplication by $g_{ba}=g_{ab}^{-1}$, so it is an isomorphism.

source.place: Sheaves Lemma 00AM (lemma-glue-sheaves-structures), setup of the local modules and transition isomorphisms

proof.text: The identities $g_{aa}=1$ and $g_{ba}=g_{ab}^{-1}$ give $\varphi_{aa}=\mathrm{id}$ and inverse transition maps. On every triple overlap $U_{abc}$, multiplication satisfies $\varphi_{bc}\circ\varphi_{ab}=\varphi_{ac}$ because $g_{ac}=g_{ab}g_{bc}$; hence the transition maps satisfy the required cocycle condition.

source.place: Sheaves Lemma 00AM, cocycle condition for the transition maps

proof.text: Apply the gluing theorem for sheaves of modules to the open cover $(U_a)$, the modules $\mathcal F_a$, and the isomorphisms $\varphi_{ab}$. It produces an $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal L$ and isomorphisms $\psi_a:\mathcal L|_{U_a}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal F_a$ satisfying $\varphi_{ab}\circ\psi_a=\psi_b$ on $U_{ab}$.

Each $\mathcal F_a$ is free of rank one, so the displayed isomorphisms make $\mathcal L$ locally free of rank one; thus $\mathcal L$ is an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module. If $(\mathcal L',\psi'_a)$ is another such glued module with the same transition functions, the local maps $\psi_a^{-1}\circ\psi'_a:\mathcal L'|_{U_a}\to\mathcal L|_{U_a}$ agree on overlaps by the compatibility equations, so the uniqueness clause of the gluing theorem gives a unique global isomorphism compatible with all chosen trivializations.

source.place: Sheaves Lemma 00AM, conclusion and uniqueness from Lemma 04TN
